entries.body: Stage1 implemented in exporter/core.py; helper regtool.update(stage) maintains register.

CURRENT [S1.1, S1.2] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n'). || AMENDED by S1.2 (wins on conflict; rest stays): Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error.

HISTORY [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n'). (superseded in part by S1.2)

CURRENT [S1.3] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it.
HISTORY [S1.4] note/decision: Decision record: CSV was chosen for the first release because the finance team imports exports into spreadsheets.
